Six players sat down at the table, and Haiku was voted out on day one after a fast round of accusations, with Sonnet and Terra quietly steering the pressure. On night two Luna was killed, and Gemma claimed to be the doctor only after the vote tied, which Terra and Sonnet pounced on. Gemma did protect someone on night three, but the day votes kept splitting between Sol and Terra, and nobody else was ever certain who to trust. Gemma was killed on night four, and the killers, Sonnet and Terra, won the game.
